components.name: State Scheduler · Research Archive
components.summary_en: Performance MOD positioning withdrawn. Code and negative results from the merged Compilation Control and State Scheduler line are retained as Compilation Control research materials. Current action sets are stopped; version 0.2.0 remains an offline tool archive, not a serving acceleration recommendation or active OSDI submission mainline.
components.summary_zh: 已撤下性能 MOD 定位。合并 Compilation Control 与 State Scheduler 后的代码与负结果保留为 Compilation Control 研究材料，当前动作集停止；0.2.0 仅供离线工具与历史复查，不推荐用于 serving 加速，也不作为当前 OSDI 投稿主线。
components.public_effect_en: No verified speedup. Tuned FULL/PIECEWISE showed no stable strategy reversal; P1 lacked a qualified correctness reference. P2 implemented preparation reuse but failed strict acceptance; native/native also failed with finite outputs, so cache-specific fault is unresolved and AB/BA was not run. Code, raw evidence and archive checksums are retained; LatchMoE and MoE Control are unchanged.
components.public_effect_zh: 无已验证提速。FULL/PIECEWISE 调优后未发现稳定策略反转，P1 未通过正确性参考门槛；P2 已实现准备复用，但严格验收失败，原生/原生也在有限值输出上失败，无法归因为缓存错误，未跑 AB/BA。代码、原始证据与归档校验和保留；LatchMoE 和 MoE Control 不变。

compatibility.host: Archived offline research tools; no qualified serving acceleration
platforms: CPU packaging and discovery verified; CUDA/Ascend adaptive execution unverified
compatibility.requirements_en: Historical inspection only in a dedicated environment; do not activate as a serving optimization. Published 0.2.0 assets and hashes are unchanged and do not include the later P2 prototype. execution_selector_available=false; runtime_benefit_qualified=false. Reopening requires an independent justified correctness reference, not relaxed tolerances.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 仅在专用环境进行历史复查，不要作为 serving 优化启用。公开 0.2.0 制品与 hash 未改，不包含后续 P2 原型。execution_selector_available=false，runtime_benefit_qualified=false。仅有独立且可信的正确性参考后才考虑重启，不放宽容差。

components.name: vLLM-HUST Runtime
components.summary_en: Upstream-synchronized HUST fork of official vLLM and owner of the default-off KV observer v1/v2 host seam. It is a runtime distribution, not a plugin; observer callbacks run only after an opted-in plugin registers them.
components.summary_zh: 与官方 vLLM 上游同步的 HUST fork，也是默认关闭的 KV observer v1/v2 宿主契约所有者。它是运行时发行分支，不是插件；只有显式启用的插件完成注册后才会触发观测回调。

components.name: vLLM-HUST Extension Manager
components.summary_en: Provider-neutral discovery, compatibility, configuration, state, plan, render, check, and supervised-run layer. ECPA 0.3.0 is published as pinned GitHub Release artifacts after dual-Python CI, clean-wheel qualification, and one process-observed native Ascend lifecycle. This release does not promote every MOD, Provider, or performance claim to stable support.
components.summary_zh: Provider-neutral 的发现、兼容性、配置、状态、plan、render、check 与受监管运行层。ECPA 0.3.0 在双 Python CI、clean-wheel 验收及一次带进程观测证据的原生昇腾生命周期通过后，以固定 GitHub Release 制品发布；这不代表所有 MOD、Provider 或性能结论都自动升级为稳定支持。

components.name: vLLM Production Stack HUST
components.summary_en: Thin HUST fork of the upstream Kubernetes control plane, owning only the arm64 carrier and narrowly required integration fixes. Controller reconciliation, metrics-backed scaling, and real GLM Router failure/recovery are verified. Commit 7611dfa was built, smoke-tested, and published to GHCR by GitHub-hosted runners, then pulled and entrypoint-tested in an arm64 validation environment; amd64 is not required, and self-hosted infrastructure is not a dependency.
components.summary_zh: 官方 Kubernetes 控制面的 HUST 薄 fork，仅承载 arm64 发布载体和极少必要集成补丁；commit 7611dfa 已由 GitHub-hosted runner 构建、烟测并发布 GHCR，随后在 arm64 验证环境完成拉取与入口验收，不要求 amd64 或 self-hosted 基础设施。

components.name: vLLM Ascend HUST
components.summary_en: Upstream-synchronized HUST fork of official vLLM Ascend, delivered as the Ascend platform distribution paired with vLLM-HUST; it is not a HUST plugin.
components.summary_zh: 与官方 vLLM Ascend 上游同步的 HUST fork，作为与 vLLM-HUST 配套的 Ascend 平台发行分支交付；它不是 HUST 插件。

components.name: vLLM Metal HUST
components.summary_en: HUST fork of official vLLM Metal for Apple Silicon platform integration; it is a complete platform distribution, not a plugin.
components.summary_zh: 面向 Apple Silicon 平台集成的官方 vLLM Metal HUST fork；它是完整平台发行分支，不是插件。

components.name: Triton Ascend HUST
components.summary_en: HUST fork of official Triton Ascend and the compiler/kernel runtime substrate used for Ascend validation; it is not a vLLM plugin.
components.summary_zh: 官方 Triton Ascend 的 HUST fork，也是昇腾验证所用的编译器与算子运行时底座；它不是 vLLM 插件。

components.name: SGLang HUST
components.summary_en: HUST fork of official SGLang and a sibling inference-runtime distribution; it is an independent system, not a vLLM-HUST plugin.
components.summary_zh: 官方 SGLang 的 HUST fork，也是独立的同级推理运行时发行分支；它不是 vLLM-HUST 插件。

components.name: Mooncake HUST
components.catalog_role_en: External Mooncake KV service and its upstream-synchronized HUST distribution.
components.catalog_role_zh: Mooncake 外部 KV 服务及其上游同步的 HUST 发行分支。
components.summary_en: Thin, upstream-first HUST fork of Mooncake. Upstream already supplies Ascend NPU and arm64 release paths, so the fork currently carries no core delta; verified paths include non-CUDA TCP/Store and the 0.3.11.post1 Ascend transport.
components.summary_zh: 上游优先的 Mooncake HUST 薄 fork。官方已提供 Ascend NPU 与 arm64 发布路径，因此当前不维护核心差异；已验证 non-CUDA TCP/Store 与 0.3.11.post1 Ascend transport。

components.name: Mooncake vLLM Connectors
components.catalog_project_summary_en: One Mooncake project with two separately governed components: the external KV service and the official vLLM connector. They are shown together here; HUST validates the Ascend integration without claiming ownership of either upstream component.
components.catalog_project_summary_zh: 同一个 Mooncake 项目包含两个治理边界不同的组件：外部 KV 服务与官方 vLLM connector。页面合并展示二者；HUST 只验证昇腾集成，不主张任一上游组件的所有权。
components.catalog_role_en: Official vLLM connector and the HUST-validated Ascend integration path.
components.catalog_role_zh: 官方 vLLM connector 与 HUST 验证的昇腾集成路径。
components.summary_en: Official vLLM MooncakeStoreConnector validated on Ascend with 9-key save/load and outage/recovery evidence; the non-invasive Host Provider checks NPU transport and operation evidence while Mooncake retains service ownership. A separate manager-launched Qwen3.5 benchmark setting tested AscendStoreConnector + Mooncake at five matched points, with throughput 1.02%–2.66% lower; these are not performance results for the official connector.
components.summary_zh: 官方 vLLM MooncakeStoreConnector 已在 Ascend 完成 9-key save/load 与故障恢复实测；无侵入 Host Provider 检查 NPU transport 和操作证据，Mooncake 仍保留服务所有权。另一个 Qwen3.5 实验设定通过插件管理器测试 AscendStoreConnector + Mooncake：五档匹配对照吞吐低 1.02%–2.66%，并非官方连接器路径的性能结论。
components.public_effect_en: The official MooncakeStoreConnector has functional save/load and outage/recovery evidence. The separate AscendStoreConnector + Mooncake measurements are deliberately not scored on this card because they did not exercise the official connector.
components.public_effect_zh: 官方 MooncakeStoreConnector 已有 save/load 与故障恢复功能证据。另一组 AscendStoreConnector + Mooncake 测量未执行官方 connector，因此不会归入此卡片的性能分数。

compatibility.requirements_en: A separately operated Mooncake service is required.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 需要单独运行并运维 Mooncake 服务。

components.name: PegaFlow
components.catalog_role_en: External PegaFlow KV service developed by the upstream PPIO / Novita AI team.
components.catalog_role_zh: 派欧云团队开发的 PegaFlow 外部 KV 服务。
components.summary_en: PegaFlow is an external KV-state service developed by the upstream PPIO / Novita AI team. It persists and reloads KV state across serving instances through an operator-managed service; the HUST adaptation adds Ascend/NPU device transfer, host IPC, and vLLM integration paths. The project is incubating. Current verification is limited to the pinned Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 profile on Ascend 910B2 with TP2/PP1; other models, devices, topologies, and service-capacity settings remain unqualified.
components.summary_zh: PegaFlow 是派欧云团队开发的外部 KV 状态服务，通过独立运维的服务在推理实例之间保存和恢复 KV 状态；HUST 适配补充了昇腾/NPU 设备传输、主机 IPC 与 vLLM 集成路径。项目当前处于孵化阶段，已验证范围限于 Ascend 910B2、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16、TP2/PP1 的固定配置；其他模型、设备、并行拓扑与服务容量尚未完成资格验证。

components.name: PegaFlow vLLM Connectors
components.catalog_project_summary_en: One PegaFlow project developed by the upstream PPIO / Novita AI team. The external KV service and its vLLM connector are shown as components of that project; HUST maintains only the Ascend/NPU and ECPA adaptation.
components.catalog_project_summary_zh: PegaFlow 是派欧云团队开发的一个项目。外部 KV 服务与 vLLM connector 在这里作为同一项目的两个组件合并展示；HUST 只维护昇腾/NPU 与 ECPA 国产化适配。
components.catalog_role_en: vLLM connector plus the HUST Ascend/NPU and ECPA adaptation.
components.catalog_role_zh: vLLM connector，以及 HUST 的昇腾/NPU 与 ECPA 国产化适配。
components.summary_en: This component connects vLLM-HUST to an operator-managed PegaFlow service and supplies the Ascend/NPU and ECPA adaptation for KV save/load. Manifest 0.3 packages the Host Provider in the runtime-owned Bundle and fails closed when the external service is unavailable; it does not start, scale, or repair that service, and it does not own stored-data lifecycle. The component is incubating, with performance evidence only for the pinned Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 profile on Ascend 910B2; broader compatibility is not yet established.
components.summary_zh: 本组件把 vLLM-HUST 接入由外部运维者管理的 PegaFlow 服务，并提供 KV save/load 的昇腾/NPU 与 ECPA 适配。Manifest 0.3 将 Host Provider 打包进 runtime 持有的 Bundle，外部服务不可用时执行 fail-closed；它不负责启动、扩缩或修复 PegaFlow 服务，也不接管已存数据的生命周期。组件当前处于孵化阶段，仅在 Ascend 910B2、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 的固定配置上形成性能证据，尚不能外推到其他模型、设备或拓扑。
components.public_effect_en: On the exact Qwen3.5-35B BF16 setting, the five-point geometric-mean output-throughput change is +6.34% versus the shared Native series; C1 regresses while C2-C16 improve.
components.public_effect_zh: 在完全相同的 Qwen3.5-35B BF16 设定下，相对统一 Native 曲线，五点输出吞吐几何平均变化为 +6.34%；C1 回退，C2-C16 提升。

compatibility.requirements_en: PegaFlow remains an external operator-owned service. The measured profile requires a 30 GiB pinned pool, PegaKVConnector read_write mode, APC, async scheduling, Mamba align, and native MTP2. Capacity planning, fault recovery, and stored-data retention remain external responsibilities; results must not be generalized beyond the pinned model, device, and parallel topology.
compatibility.requirements_zh: PegaFlow 仍是由外部运维者管理的服务；实测 profile 要求 30 GiB pinned pool、PegaKVConnector read_write、APC、异步调度、Mamba align 与原生 MTP2。容量规划、故障恢复和数据留存仍由外部服务承担，结果不得外推到固定模型、设备与并行拓扑之外。

components.name: ADM
components.summary_en: Opt-in, version-pinned Ascend DP scheduling-metadata plugin. It preserves the native token vector and graph-mode result while packing DP2 and DP4 rank metadata into one CPU-group all-reduce word.
components.summary_zh: 按版本固定、默认关闭的昇腾 DP 调度元数据插件；保持原生 token 向量和图模式结果，将 DP2、DP4 各 rank 元数据打包到一次 CPU 组 all-reduce。
components.public_effect_en: On Qwen3-30B-A3B-W8A8 TP1/DP4, three matched session means favored the new word path by 0.38%, 0.71%, and 1.32% against the previous published MOD; aggregate output throughput was 467.099 vs 463.376 tok/s (+0.80%). Individual rounds varied. This does not establish general speedup or research recovery acceptance.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen3-30B-A3B-W8A8 TP1/DP4 三组配对会话相对先前已发布 MOD 分别提升 0.38%、0.71%、1.32%；输出吞吐总均值为 467.099 对 463.376 tok/s（+0.80%）。单轮存在波动，不代表普遍提速或研究恢复验收。

effectiveness_qualifications.scope: Qwen3-30B-A3B-W8A8 · DP4 · three paired sessions · +0.80% mean output throughput vs previous MOD
Qwen3.5-35B-A3B · TP4/DP2 eager · service gain not established

models: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B — DP2 functional; throughput benefit unconfirmed
compatibility.requirements_en: The Manifest 0.3 wheel is discoverable and clean-wheel tested. ECPA may express enable intent, but launch still requires the exact runtime-qualification profile; packaging does not widen the published performance result or make ADM a recovery protocol.
compatibility.requirements_zh: Manifest 0.3 wheel 已可发现并通过 clean-wheel 测试。ECPA 可表达启用意图，但启动仍要求精确匹配 runtime-qualification profile；打包不会扩大既有性能结论，也不会把 ADM 变成恢复协议。

components.name: BidKV
integration_surfaces: vLLM-HUST preemption-policy API v1 (organization PR #11 merged)
components.summary_en: BidKV uses the merged vLLM-HUST preemption-policy API v1 with bounded safe abstention. The latest Qwen3.5-35B-A3B TP4 KV-pressure campaign preserves two positive C12 pairs, active policy selections, negative tuning trials and shutdown diagnostics; it remains separate from the older TP2/SWE and Qwen3.8 observations.
components.summary_zh: BidKV 使用已合并的 vLLM-HUST preemption-policy API v1 与有界安全弃权。最新 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B TP4 KV-pressure 实验保留两轮 C12 正向配对、真实策略选择、负向调参试验与退出诊断，并与旧 TP2/SWE 和 Qwen3.8 观察严格分开。
components.public_effect_en: In the Qwen3.5 TP4 C12 cell with 512 MiB KV per NPU, two alternating-order pairs improved output throughput by 17.11% and 10.65% (13.83% geometric mean; 13.88% arithmetic mean). BidKV made 10 and 7 active selections with zero policy failures. Other retained cells are negative or not exercised, so this is a tested-cell result, not a general speedup claim.
components.public_effect_zh: 在 Qwen3.5 TP4 C12、每 NPU 512 MiB KV 的测试单元中，两轮交替顺序配对的输出吞吐分别提升 17.11% 与 10.65%（几何平均 13.83%，算术平均 13.88%）。BidKV 分别执行 10 与 7 次有效选择，策略失败为 0。其余保留单元为负向或未触发，因此这只是已测单元结果，不代表普遍加速。

functional_compatibility.scope: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B · Ascend TP4 · FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph; Qwen3.8-27B · Ascend TP4 · FULL_DECODE_ONLY graph

effectiveness_qualifications.scope: Qwen3.5 TP4 · C12 · 512 MiB KV/NPU · n=2 paired repeats

models: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B — TP4 C12 KV-pressure measured; tested-cell benefit
Qwen3.8-27B — artifact functional qualified; effectiveness matrix incomplete
compatibility.requirements_en: The Qwen3.5 result used Core f18cf803, Ascend 249ac12 plus the recorded build patch, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph, C12 and 512 MiB KV/NPU. Do not pool it with the TP2/SWE five-point observation or the older Qwen3.8 matrix. Functional compatibility, per-cell effectiveness, and live runtime-effective state are separate facts.
compatibility.requirements_zh: Qwen3.5 结果使用 Core f18cf803、Ascend 249ac12 加已记录构建补丁、FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph、C12 与每 NPU 512 MiB KV。不得与 TP2/SWE 五点观察或旧 Qwen3.8 矩阵合并。功能兼容、逐单元效果与当前实例 runtime-effective 状态是不同事实。

components.name: DiffSpec
components.summary_en: DiffSpec 9986978 adapts current Eagle3, Ascend attention, model-runner, sampler and speculative metadata surfaces on Core 762f85b3 and Ascend 4e57439e. Qwen3.8-27B with the qualified Eagle3 draft passed the TP4 graph functional matrix, with performance degradation.
components.summary_zh: DiffSpec 9986978 已适配 Core 762f85b3 与 Ascend 4e57439e 的当前 Eagle3、Ascend attention、model runner、sampler 和 speculative metadata 接口；Qwen3.8-27B 搭配已验证 Eagle3 draft 通过 TP4 graph 功能矩阵，但性能退化。
components.public_effect_en: The real TP4 graph run accepted 103/534 draft tokens (19.29%). Warm TTFT P50/P95 was 0.459/0.469 s and output throughput P50/P95 was 14.00/14.24 tok/s, slower than target-only; this is compatibility evidence, not a speedup claim.
components.public_effect_zh: 真实 TP4 graph 运行接受 103/534 个 draft token（19.29%）；预热后 TTFT P50/P95 为 0.459/0.469 秒，输出吞吐 P50/P95 为 14.00/14.24 tok/s，低于 target-only，因此仅证明兼容，不构成加速声明。

compatibility.requirements_en: Qualified image sha256:6dec9e68... with the hashed VirVen draft. Installed, configured and enabled are intent states; runtime effective requires four-rank ACLGraph markers and nonzero draft/accepted counters. No acceleration recommendation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 已验证镜像 sha256:6dec9e68...，并绑定带哈希的 VirVen draft。installed、configured、enabled 是意图状态；runtime effective 还必须看到四 rank ACLGraph 标记以及非零 draft/accepted 计数。不得宣称加速推荐。

components.name: vSpec
components.summary_en: vSpec is an in-process speculative-decoding MOD for vLLM-HUST and vLLM-Ascend-HUST. It exposes Draft and EAGLE launchers, dynamic gamma, and online/profile adaptive control while keeping the host model registry unchanged through delayed plugin registration.
components.summary_zh: vSpec 是面向 vLLM-HUST 与 vLLM-Ascend-HUST 的进程内投机解码 MOD，提供 Draft / EAGLE 启动器、动态 gamma 与 online/profile 自适应控制，并通过延迟插件注册保持宿主模型注册表不变。
components.public_effect_en: The repository reports a same-card GSM8K B128 recovery result of 1.518x. That result is specific to the published Qwen2.5 configuration; adaptive control does not guarantee a gain for other models, batch sizes, or request distributions.
components.public_effect_zh: 仓库公开了同卡 GSM8K B128 的 1.518x 恢复验证；该结果仅适用于已发布的 Qwen2.5 配置，自适应控制不保证其他模型、batch 或请求分布同样获益。

compatibility.requirements_en: Use the published model pair and verify the host ABI with vllm-hust-vspec-doctor before enablement. Manager discovery is static; enabling requires an explicit compatibility check, and runtime effectiveness must be verified from live speculative-decoding counters.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 请使用已发布的模型组合，并在启用前通过 vllm-hust-vspec-doctor 核对宿主 ABI。Manager 仅作静态发现；启用前必须显式完成兼容性检查，运行时是否生效还需查看真实投机解码计数器。

components.name: LatchMoE
integration_surfaces: vllm-ascend-hust MoE offload seam v2 (organization PR #9 merged)
components.summary_en: LatchMoE is not applicable to dense Qwen3.8-27B. Version 0.3.0 is now packaged under the Extension Bundle contract with a narrowed TP1 PIECEWISE functional release scope. Its published throughput comparison remains a separate historical Qwen3-30B-A3B TP4 graph artifact and is substantially degraded.
components.summary_zh: LatchMoE 0.3.0 已按 Extension Bundle 合同打包，当前功能发行范围收窄为 TP1 PIECEWISE。公开吞吐对比仍属于独立的历史 Qwen3-30B-A3B TP4 制品，且性能明显退化；dense Qwen3.8-27B 不适用。
components.public_effect_en: All four ranks exercised expert mapping, host/device movement and graph replay with 48/48 stable-address checks. Four concurrent outputs, cancellation and exception recovery passed; output throughput was about 2.91 tok/s versus 23.57 tok/s without the plugin.
components.public_effect_zh: 四个 rank 均实际执行专家映射、主机/设备换入换出与 graph replay，48/48 地址稳定性检查通过；四路并发输出、取消与异常恢复通过，但输出吞吐约 2.91 tok/s，显著低于无插件基线的 23.57 tok/s。

functional_compatibility.scope: Qwen3-30B-A3B · Ascend TP4 · PIECEWISE graph; Qwen3.8-27B not applicable

versions: Historical TP4 performance artifact 63781f3d · Core 762f85b3 + Ascend 4e57439e/seam-v2
platforms: Current release scope: Ascend NPU · TP1 · PIECEWISE · prefix cache off
Historical performance scope: Ascend NPU · TP4 · PIECEWISE graph
models: Qwen3-30B-A3B — current TP1 functional release scope; historical TP4 performance degraded
compatibility.requirements_en: The current 0.3.0 package scope and the historical TP4 performance artifact are different qualifications. The -87.65% card result belongs only to artifact 63781f3d on Qwen3-30B-A3B BF16 TP4 PIECEWISE graph with max_num_seqs=4; it must not be transferred to the TP1 release package.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 当前 0.3.0 包范围与历史 TP4 性能制品是两项不同资格。卡片中的 -87.65% 仅属于制品 63781f3d 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B BF16、TP4 PIECEWISE、max_num_seqs=4 下的结果，不得转移到 TP1 发行包。

components.name: OpFuse
components.summary_en: Default-off, single-mechanism operator-fusion runtime-patch plugin for vLLM-HUST on Ascend NPU, currently a scaffold from patch-plugin-template with the fusion mechanism target under design.
components.summary_zh: 面向 vLLM-HUST 昇腾 NPU 的默认关闭、单一机制算子融合运行时补丁插件，当前为 patch-plugin-template 脚手架，融合机制目标设计中。
components.public_effect_en: No performance effect is claimed yet. The repository is a scaffold with differential tests passing; the operator-fusion mechanism has not been implemented or measured online.
components.public_effect_zh: 暂不主张任何性能效果。仓库当前为脚手架（差分测试通过）；算子融合机制尚未实现，也未做在线实测。

functional_compatibility.scope: scaffold only; not yet qualified on Ascend 910B2

effectiveness_qualifications.scope: no online measurement yet; mechanism target pending

compatibility.requirements_en: Scaffold stage: default-off register(), enable via VLLM_HUST_OPFUSE_ENABLE=1, kill switch wins. Loading through dev-hub optimization profiles is planned via .vllm-hust/optimization.json.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 脚手架阶段：默认关闭，需 VLLM_HUST_OPFUSE_ENABLE=1 启用，kill switch 优先。计划通过 dev-hub 的 .vllm-hust/optimization.json 接入优化 profile。

components.name: Adaptive Quantized KV
components.summary_en: Installable, discoverable research descriptor with compatibility receipts. It remains import-only, and the Extension Manager refuses enablement until vLLM Ascend provides the observer and ACL Graph lifecycle contracts.
components.summary_zh: 可安装、可发现并带兼容性回执的研究描述包；当前仍为 import-only，在 vLLM Ascend 提供 observer 与 ACL Graph 生命周期合同前，Extension Manager 会拒绝启用。
components.public_effect_en: Packaging, inert discovery, and compatibility receipts pass on Python 3.10, 3.12, and 3.14. No runtime or performance result is claimed yet.
components.public_effect_zh: Python 3.10、3.12、3.14 已通过打包、惰性发现与兼容性回执验证；当前不声明运行时或性能效果。

compatibility.requirements_en: Observer and ACL Graph lifecycle contracts are not available yet.
compatibility.requirements_zh: observer 与 ACL Graph 生命周期合同尚未提供。

components.name: Ascend Quant Toolkit
components.summary_en: Offline model-artifact preparation toolkit with a bundled fail-closed artifact validator. The validator is a toolkit subcomponent, not a second runtime MOD; serving activation still requires typed vLLM Ascend loader/operator contracts. Public package publication is blocked pending an owner license declaration.
components.summary_zh: 离线模型产物制备工具，包含 fail-closed 产物校验器。该校验器是工具子组件，不是第二个运行时 MOD；服务激活仍需 vLLM Ascend typed loader/operator 合同。公共包发布仍等待负责人声明许可证。
components.public_effect_en: Offline artifact preparation and contract validation only. CPU smoke tests cover versioned metadata generation and rejection of unknown schemas, layouts, or operator configurations; no online latency, throughput, quality, or NPU runtime benefit is claimed.
components.public_effect_zh: 仅用于离线产物准备和合同校验。CPU smoke 覆盖版本化元数据生成，以及对未知 schema、布局或算子配置的拒绝；不声明在线延迟、吞吐、质量或 NPU 运行时收益。

components.name: Ascend KV Compression
components.summary_en: KV transformation and compression provider for vLLM Ascend. The measured Qwen3.5 artifact supports hybrid cache groups, APC, asynchronous scheduling and MTP2; current main additionally carries method-neutral per-layer physical state and query-observation support for graph replay.
components.summary_zh: vLLM Ascend KV 状态转换与压缩 provider。已测 Qwen3.5 制品支持混合缓存分组、APC、异步调度与 MTP2；当前 main 还加入了面向 graph replay 的方法无关逐层物理状态与 query observation 支持。
components.public_effect_en: On the exact Qwen3.5-35B BF16 setting, the five-point geometric-mean output-throughput change is -3.55% versus the shared Native series.
components.public_effect_zh: 在完全相同的 Qwen3.5-35B BF16 设定下，相对统一 Native 曲线，五个并发点的输出吞吐几何平均变化为 -3.55%。

versions: Current compatibility head d5507c2 (per-layer MTP graph replay; no performance transfer)
compatibility.requirements_en: The -3.55% observation is pinned to measured artifact 2ca0f933 and is not a performance claim for current main d5507c2. The measured setting used ECPA, TP2, aligned hybrid KV groups, APC, asynchronous scheduling and native MTP2. Runtime effectiveness requires cache-binding and compression-commit evidence.
compatibility.requirements_zh: -3.55% 观察固定属于实测制品 2ca0f933，不构成当前 main d5507c2 的性能结论。实测设定通过 ECPA 启动，使用 TP2、align 混合 KV 分组、APC、异步调度和原生 MTP2；运行时生效需同时观测缓存绑定与压缩提交。

components.name: Prefix Router
components.summary_en: Installable external prefix/lifecycle-aware router with bounded backend pools, request-load accounting, authoritative KV-event recovery, OpenAI-compatible forwarding, and health/readiness/metrics endpoints.
components.summary_zh: 可独立安装的外部前缀与生命周期感知 Router，提供有界 backend 连接池、请求负载核算、权威 KV 事件恢复、OpenAI 兼容转发以及健康、就绪和指标接口。
components.public_effect_en: Three matched 900-second rounds at C1/C2/C4/C8/C16 reported 0.96%–17.52% higher throughput than the same two-replica random-routing deployment. Source-integrity gaps in several Prometheus files prevent per-request causal attribution.
components.public_effect_zh: C1/C2/C4/C8/C16 各三轮匹配的 900 秒实验，相对相同双副本随机路由部署记录到 0.96%–17.52% 的吞吐提升。部分 Prometheus 源文件存在完整性缺口，不能作逐请求因果归因。

compatibility.host: External router over vLLM-HUST request fingerprint and KV events
compatibility.requirements_en: Operate the router as a separate service and keep tokenizer, block size, hash algorithm, host version and PYTHONHASHSEED aligned with workers. The published measurements compare Prefix ON with random routing, not with a no-proxy native server.
compatibility.requirements_zh: Router 需作为独立服务运维，并与 worker 对齐 tokenizer、block size、hash algorithm、宿主版本及 PYTHONHASHSEED。已发布测量对比 Prefix ON 与随机路由，而非无代理 Native 服务。

components.name: KV Tiering
components.summary_en: Experimental device/CPU/filesystem KV tiering packaged as an ECPA 0.3 custom Provider. The merged package is inspectable; current-host activation and recovery remain separate gates.
components.summary_zh: 实验性的设备、CPU、文件系统 KV 分层，已打包为 ECPA 0.3 自定义 Provider。合并后的包可检查；当前宿主激活与恢复仍是独立门槛。
components.public_effect_en: Five Qwen3.5 TP2 concurrency points and matched Native controls are measured through Extension Manager. Throughput is 2.33–5.23% lower in these single observations; all windows show cache stores but zero restores, so no reuse benefit is demonstrated.
components.public_effect_zh: 已通过插件管理器完成 Qwen3.5 TP2 五档并发及匹配 Native 对照。本次单次观测中吞吐低 2.33%–5.23%；所有窗口仅写出缓存、没有回读，未证明复用收益。

compatibility.host: ECPA 0.3 custom Provider; current host qualification pending
versions: ECPA 0.3 package 03f17227; historical runtime evidence remains pinned to Tiering 7ba646a / Host 49f0827 / Manager cf1ea71
compatibility.requirements_en: The merged ECPA 0.3 package and clean-wheel checks restore preview visibility only. Historical measurements retain their exact receipt; current main still requires host-contract, storage-consistency and recovery qualification before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 合并后的 ECPA 0.3 包及 clean-wheel 检查仅恢复预览展示。历史测量保留其精确运行清单；当前 main 在激活前仍需完成宿主契约、存储一致性与恢复验收。

components.name: KNorm
components.summary_en: Owner-led ECPA 0.3 package for the legacy KNorm KV-compression method. The bundle is clean-wheel inspectable; prefix-cache and mutation-owner conflicts remain activation gates.
components.summary_zh: 由原贡献者主导的 legacy KNorm KV 压缩方法 ECPA 0.3 包。bundle 已通过 clean-wheel 检查；prefix cache 与 KV 修改所有权冲突仍是激活门槛。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: extract KNorm as a host-governed KV compression method. The public scaffold makes no performance or quality claim yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：把 KNorm 抽取为由宿主管理的 KV 压缩方法；公开脚手架尚不声明性能或质量结果。

compatibility.requirements_en: Manifest 0.3 and clean-wheel discovery are verified. Activation remains fail-closed until operator correctness, current-host compatibility, recovery, and safe composition with prefix caching and other KV mutation owners are proven.
compatibility.requirements_zh: Manifest 0.3 与 clean-wheel 发现已验证。算子正确性、当前宿主兼容性、恢复以及与 prefix caching 和其他 KV 修改方的安全组合得到证明前，激活继续 fail closed。

components.name: PyramidKV Ascend
components.summary_en: Active PyramidKV external method for the shared Ascend KV-compression adapter. It supplies query-window scoring and unequal per-layer KV retention under a fail-closed Qwen3.5 capability matrix.
components.summary_zh: 共享昇腾 KV 压缩适配器的可激活 PyramidKV external method，在 fail-closed 的 Qwen3.5 能力矩阵下提供 query-window 打分和逐层非均匀 KV 保留。
components.public_effect_en: Paired Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2 evidence: peak KV-pool usage fell 25.47% relatively; held-out LongBench F1 fell 0.26 points. At 8K/24K, throughput fell 2.6–10.3% and device HBM rose about 0.4 GiB. These results apply only to the pinned graph-slot fix and 1368/beta=2 profile; they do not establish a general speedup.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2 配对证据：峰值 KV 池占用相对下降 25.47%，LongBench 留出集 F1 下降 0.26 个百分点；8K/24K 吞吐下降 2.6–10.3%，设备 HBM 增加约 0.4 GiB。结果仅适用于固定的 graph-slot 修复及 1368/beta=2 配置，不能据此宣称普遍加速。

compatibility.host: vLLM-HUST + vLLM-Ascend-HUST through KVCompress method API v1
compatibility.requirements_en: Requires the pinned CANN 9.1 / vLLM 0.23.0 source stack, KVCompress graph-slot backport 19f3221, TP2, APC, MTP2, async, chunked-prefill, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE and Mamba-align. The evaluated profile uses max_capacity_prompt=1368, beta=2 and threshold=4096; default 512/beta=20 failed the quality gate. Public package availability and five-dataset qualification remain open; the measured profile is not the official performance baseline.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 要求固定的 CANN 9.1 / vLLM 0.23.0 源码栈、KVCompress graph-slot 回移修复 19f3221，以及 TP2、APC、MTP2、async、chunked prefill、FULL_AND_PIECEWISE、Mamba align。通过质量门槛的配置为 max_capacity_prompt=1368、beta=2、threshold=4096；默认 512/beta=20 未通过质量门槛。公开包发布和五数据集验收仍待完成；该实测配置不属于官方性能基线。

components.name: SliceGPT
components.summary_en: Packaged SliceGPT conversion toolkit plus default-off ECPA runtime artifact loader for Llama and Qwen2/Qwen2.5, with a versioned artifact format, compatibility checks, rollback documentation, and clean-wheel lifecycle tests.
components.summary_zh: 已打包的 SliceGPT 转换 Toolkit 与默认关闭的 ECPA Runtime 产物加载器，支持 Llama 和 Qwen2/Qwen2.5，并提供版本化产物格式、兼容检查、回滚文档和 clean-wheel 生命周期测试。
components.public_effect_en: Offline conversion and package lifecycle are implemented and covered by 44 tests. Real CUDA/NPU model loading, serving restoration, accuracy, memory, and performance remain unqualified.
components.public_effect_zh: 离线转换和包生命周期已经实现并通过 44 项测试；真实 CUDA/NPU 模型加载、服务恢复、精度、显存和性能仍未验收。

compatibility.host: Offline Toolkit + default-off ECPA runtime loader
platforms: Offline conversion validated; CUDA/NPU serving pending
compatibility.requirements_en: Use the versioned converted artifact and pass host compatibility checks. Real-device model loading, inference correctness, rollback and performance still require qualification.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 需使用版本化转换产物并通过宿主兼容检查；真实设备模型加载、推理正确性、回滚和性能仍需验收。

components.name: RIDE Control Plane
components.summary_en: External cross-instance decision system for admission, placement, routing, and global policy.
components.summary_zh: 负责准入、放置、路由与全局策略的外部跨实例决策系统。

components.name: vLLM Local Control Host
components.catalog_independent_reason_en: A local authenticated host contract, distinct from the optional remote RIDE transport sidecar.
components.catalog_independent_reason_zh: 本地认证宿主合同，与可选的远程 RIDE transport sidecar 是两个独立部署边界。
components.summary_en: Default-off core host that authenticates bounded same-UID Unix-socket actions and executes the fixed read-only health probe through a process boundary.
components.summary_zh: 默认关闭的核心本地宿主：认证同 UID 的有界 Unix socket action，并通过进程边界执行固定只读健康探针。

components.name: RIDE Remote Runtime Sidecar
components.catalog_independent_reason_en: A separately deployed remote transport sidecar, not a duplicate of the local control host in the same source repository.
components.catalog_independent_reason_zh: 独立部署的远程传输 sidecar，并非同一源码仓中本地控制宿主的重复卡片。
components.summary_en: Separately built TLS 1.3 mutual-authentication sidecar that allowlists remote certificate fingerprints and transparently forwards bounded signed frames into the vLLM local control host.
components.summary_zh: 独立构建的 TLS 1.3 双向认证 sidecar：按证书指纹允许远程身份，并将有界签名帧透明转发到 vLLM 本地控制宿主。

components.name: Quantized KV Cache
components.summary_en: Ascend runtime plugin for dynamic per-channel INT8 KV cache; legacy KIVI and packed-format work remains separate migration history.
components.summary_zh: 面向昇腾的动态 per-channel INT8 KV Cache 运行时插件；KIVI 与其他 packed 格式仍属于后续迁移范围。
components.public_effect_en: Real Qwen2.5-14B single-card serving, prefill/decode, ACL Graph replay, and three OpenAI API requests are verified. No matched performance comparison has been published.
components.public_effect_zh: 已验证 Qwen2.5-14B 单卡真实服务、prefill/decode、ACL Graph 回放及三次 OpenAI API 请求；尚无已发布的配对性能对比。

compatibility.requirements_en: Activation requires --kv-cache-dtype int8. TP2, Qwen3.5 hybrid cache, APC, MTP2, asynchronous scheduling, and the current Qwen3.5 graph-mode setting remain unqualified.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 启用需传入 --kv-cache-dtype int8；TP2、Qwen3.5 hybrid cache、APC、MTP2、异步调度及当前 Qwen3.5 图模式设定仍未验收。

components.name: SimLLM
components.summary_en: Installable, default-off task-similarity KV-reuse MOD for vLLM Ascend. It performs task matching, bounded KV snapshots, worker-side reuse, and Qwen3.5 hybrid-state restoration without editing host source files.
components.summary_zh: 面向 vLLM Ascend、默认关闭且可独立安装的任务相似度 KV 复用 MOD；提供任务匹配、受限 KV snapshot、worker 侧复用和 Qwen3.5 hybrid 状态恢复，无需修改宿主源码。
components.public_effect_en: Two independent 5,000-request Qwen3.5 W8A8 replays reported throughput gains of 20.39% and 18.78%, with lower median and p95 TTFT. The fixed-card, one-output-token workload primarily measures prefill and does not establish long-generation benefit.
components.public_effect_zh: 两次独立的 5,000 请求 Qwen3.5 W8A8 回放分别记录到 20.39% 与 18.78% 的吞吐提升，同时 TTFT 中位数和 p95 下降。该固定卡、单输出 token 负载主要衡量 prefill，不能推广为长生成收益。

models: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B W8A8 — fixed-card one-output-token similarity replay
compatibility.requirements_en: Enable explicitly through Extension Manager with VLLM_ASCEND_SIMLLM_ENABLED=1 and use the tested host internals, block size, cache, and prefill settings. Approximate reuse is workload-specific; long-generation performance remains unqualified.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 需通过 Extension Manager 显式启用并设置 VLLM_ASCEND_SIMLLM_ENABLED=1，同时匹配已测宿主内部接口、block size、cache 与 prefill 配置。近似复用依赖特定负载，长生成性能尚未验证。

components.name: Unified Communication
components.summary_en: Device-neutral communication MOD with NCCL/HCCL backends, collective operations, transfer planes and communication strategies. Legacy implementations integrated GroupCoordinator and added NCCL multi-NIC bandwidth aggregation; the standalone version is being migrated.
components.summary_zh: 设备中立的统一通信 MOD，提供 NCCL/HCCL 后端、集合通信、传输面与通信策略抽象。历史实现已接入 GroupCoordinator，并加入 NCCL 多网卡带宽聚合；独立版本正在迁移接入。
components.public_effect_en: Historical implementations exist: merged core PRs #42 and #168 cover unified communication integration and NCCL multi-NIC support. The standalone package remains inspect-only; this is not a claim of current activation or measured speedup.
components.public_effect_zh: 已有历史实现：核心 PR #42 与 #168 均已合并，包含统一通信接入及 NCCL 多网卡支持。当前独立包仍仅可安装与检查，尚不代表新版本可启用或已验证加速。

compatibility.requirements_en: The device-neutral registry and strategy wheel is installable and inspectable; backend packages, collective delegation, and hardware evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 设备中立的 registry 与策略 wheel 可安装、可检查；激活前仍需后端包、collective delegation 与硬件证据。

components.name: Split-Batch / Full-Graph Parallel
components.summary_en: Owner-led carrier for split-batch planning, dual-stream replay, and full-graph parallel execution; core retains graph-lifecycle ownership.
components.summary_zh: split-batch 规划、双流 replay 与 full-graph 并行执行的原负责人迁移载体；graph 生命周期仍由 core 拥有。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: split-batch planning, dual-stream replay, and full-graph parallel execution. Public matched performance results are not available yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：split-batch 规划、双流 replay 与 full-graph 并行执行；尚无公开配对性能结果。

compatibility.requirements_en: The default-off dual-pad planner and prechecks are installable and inspectable; graph/worker execution contracts and Ascend validation are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 默认关闭的 dual-pad planner 与前置检查可安装、可检查；激活前仍需 graph/worker 执行合同与昇腾验证。

components.name: KV Transfer Observability
components.summary_en: Manifest 0.3 KV-transfer observer for bounded worker receipts and v2-correlated recovery chains through requeue, admission, and first compute. Its validator rejects incomplete, duplicate, or reused identities; it owns neither KV data nor service lifecycle.
components.summary_zh: Manifest 0.3 KV 传输 observer：记录有界 Worker 回执，并以 v2 身份串联重新入队、准入和首次计算的恢复链。校验器会拒绝不完整、重复或复用身份的链路；插件不拥有 KV 数据，也不接管服务生命周期。
components.public_effect_en: Experimental host-contract evidence covers clean-wheel ECPA activation, real v1/v2 callbacks, correlated recovery artifacts, process-owned runtime-effective evidence, stop, and post-exit expiry. A single-card Ascend diagnostic also passed, but it included an unmerged Ascend call-site change, so this is not release-level NPU qualification or a speedup claim.
components.public_effect_zh: 实验性宿主契约证据覆盖 clean-wheel ECPA 激活、真实 v1/v2 回调、关联恢复制品、进程自有 runtime-effective 证据、停止及退出后证据失效。单卡昇腾诊断也已通过，但包含尚未合入的 Ascend 调用点修改，因此不代表发布级 NPU 资格，也不声明加速。

compatibility.host: vLLM-HUST main @ 5a820400 with KV observer v1 plus optional v2 correlation
platforms: CPU packaging, current-host callback and lifecycle evidence; NPU qualification incomplete
compatibility.requirements_en: Activation and correlated recovery validation are available on the merged host contract. Release qualification still requires merged Ascend call sites, descriptor ordering, multi-rank and V2-runner coverage, device correctness/resource release, overhead, and performance evidence.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 在已合入的宿主契约上可完成激活和关联恢复校验。发布资格仍需合入 Ascend 调用点，并补齐 descriptor 顺序、多 rank、V2 runner、设备正确性与资源释放、开销和性能证据。

components.name: Layered Prefill
components.summary_en: Owner-led optional layered-prefill carrier. The HUST integration must remain distinct from the MIT upstream project and disabled by default.
components.summary_zh: 可选 layered-prefill 的原负责人迁移载体；HUST 集成须与 MIT 上游项目区分，并保持默认关闭。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: optional layered prefill behind an explicit, default-off integration boundary. Public HUST-specific benchmark results are not available yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：以显式、默认关闭的接入边界提供 layered prefill；尚无 HUST 集成专属公开 benchmark。

compatibility.requirements_en: Stage partitioning, request metadata, model-adapter declarations, and MoE cursor logic are installable and inspectable; partial-forward attachment, opt-in proof, and Ascend evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 阶段划分、请求 metadata、model-adapter 声明与 MoE cursor 逻辑可安装、可检查；激活前仍需 partial-forward 接入、opt-in 证明与昇腾证据。

components.name: Activation Sparsity
components.summary_en: Owner-led TEAL and LaRoSA research carrier. No sparse kernel, quality, model, hardware, or support claim is made from the unmerged source PR.
components.summary_zh: TEAL 与 LaRoSA 的原负责人研究载体；来源 PR 未合并，不声明 sparse kernel、质量、模型、硬件或支持范围。
components.public_effect_en: Research preview: package TEAL and LaRoSA activation-sparsity work behind an extension boundary. No kernel, quality, model, hardware, or speedup claim is public yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 研究预览：把 TEAL 与 LaRoSA 激活稀疏工作封装到扩展边界之后；尚不公开 kernel、质量、模型、硬件或加速声明。

compatibility.requirements_en: Fail-closed TEAL/LaRoSA configuration validation is installable and inspectable; kernel, quality, model, attachment, and hardware evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: fail-closed TEAL/LaRoSA 配置校验可安装、可检查；激活前仍需 kernel、质量、模型、接入与硬件证据。

components.name: Pipeline Microbatch
components.summary_en: Owner-led calibrated pipeline-parallel microbatch scheduling carrier spanning scheduler, executor, communication, KV, worker, and benchmark boundaries.
components.summary_zh: 校准式流水并行 microbatch 调度的原负责人研究载体，跨越 scheduler、executor、通信、KV、worker 与评测边界。
components.public_effect_en: Five Qwen3.5 TP2/PP2 concurrency observations and matched Native controls are published, accounting for all four chips. The batch admission policy was exercised; each point is a single observation and does not establish a stable speedup.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen3.5 TP2/PP2 五档并发及匹配 Native 对照已发布，吞吐按全部四张卡计量。批次准入策略实际执行；每点仍为单次观测，不能据此宣称稳定加速。

models: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B — matched four-chip TP2/PP2 five-point observation
compatibility.requirements_en: ECPA launched the measured APC, MTP2, asynchronous scheduling, Mamba align, and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE configuration. The published curve uses the matched four-chip TP2/PP2 Native control.
compatibility.requirements_zh: ECPA 已启动实测所用的 APC、MTP2、异步调度、Mamba align 与 FULL_AND_PIECEWISE 组合；公开曲线使用匹配的四卡 TP2/PP2 Native 对照。

components.name: QoS Scheduler
components.summary_en: Owner-led deadline-aware TTFT, TBT, and TTLT scheduler-policy carrier; it is not a deployment system or control plane.
components.summary_zh: 面向 TTFT、TBT 与 TTLT deadline 的原负责人 scheduler-policy 载体；不是部署系统或控制面。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: schedule against TTFT, TBT, and TTLT deadlines through a runtime policy extension. Public SLO and throughput results are pending.

components.name: Quality-Bounded Inference
components.summary_en: Task-aware control plane delivered as a vLLM-HUST Extension Bundle (manifest 0.2-experimental): it decides, per model invocation, which quality-bounded inference mechanisms to admit and delivers an admitted mechanism as a request-local parameter. Quality-policy research package whose 0.1.1 carrier exposes only a behavior-preserving, full-fidelity request observer on the stable host hook. Adaptive token-budget, admission, and scheduling mechanisms remain fail closed and are not activated by ECPA.
components.summary_zh: 以 vLLM-HUST Extension Bundle（manifest 0.2-experimental）交付的任务感知控制面：按每次模型调用决定准入哪些质量约束推理机制，并把已准入机制作为请求级参数投递；宿主未暴露请求入口读取点时 fail closed。质量策略研究包；0.1.1 carrier 只在稳定 host hook 上提供不改变行为的全保真请求 observer。自适应 token budget、准入和调度机制仍保持 fail closed，不会由 ECPA 激活。
components.public_effect_en: Experimental CPU host-contract evidence: 1,069 tests, current-host callback, clean-wheel activation, process-owned runtime evidence and supervised stop pass. This is not model-quality, NPU, adaptive-policy or performance qualification.

components.name: CLM Lifecycle

compatibility.requirements_en: Keep the Qwen3.5 unified observation and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct M2 controller study separate. The Qwen3.5 runtime exercised recompute, partial-reuse and full-reuse decisions; the M2 controller direction stopped after its preregistered negative result.

components.public_effect_en: Current 0.2.0 code is not beneficial in the tested Qwen3.5-35B-A3B TP2 eager AgentX cells. A real concurrency-2 probe failed closed and terminated the engine. A component-only host submission change was 18.33% faster while synchronized device time stayed near 68 us, so it does not establish end-to-end gain.

components.name: OPset
components.summary_en: Opt-in Ascend operator optimization bundle with independently gated persistent MatMul allocation and Graph linear-SwiGLU fusion. Only the validated batch-invariant Graph/Triton path is affected.
components.summary_zh: 可按优化项独立启用的 Ascend 算子优化包，包含 Persistent MatMul 冗余清零消除与 Graph Linear–SwiGLU 融合；仅影响已验证的 batch-invariant Graph/Triton 路径。
components.public_effect_en: On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Ascend 910B2/CANN 9.0.0, Graph/batch-invariant, a 64-request ShareGPT workload at concurrency 4 gave 3.82% lower steady-state TPOT and 5.24% higher output-token throughput across three matched rounds for linear-SwiGLU fusion. The published compatibility profile is a separate CANN 9.1 beta.3 line; cold-start performance and other paths are not covered by this result.
components.public_effect_zh: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Ascend 910B2/CANN 9.0.0、batch-invariant Graph 模式下，Linear–SwiGLU 融合于 ShareGPT 64 请求、并发 4 的三轮配对测试中，稳态 TPOT 降低 3.82%，输出 token 吞吐提高 5.24%。已发布的兼容配置是另一条 CANN 9.1 beta.3 版本线；该结果不覆盖冷启动及其他执行路径。

components.name: Request Throttling Controller
components.summary_en: External Router/Controller for program-aware admission and request scheduling. Its stable Manifest 0.3 Bundle lets ECPA discover and validate the service, record enablement intent, reject another exclusive program-admission controller, and render an operator-owned launch plan without pretending to patch vLLM in process.
components.summary_zh: 面向 program-aware 准入与请求调度的外部 Router/Controller。稳定的 Manifest 0.3 Bundle 允许 ECPA 发现和检查服务、记录启用意图、拒绝另一个独占 program-admission 控制器，并渲染由 operator 执行的启动计划；它不会伪装成进程内 vLLM patch。
components.public_effect_en: A pinned 192-concurrency, no-keepalive run reported 86.025 steps/min for the thin adapter versus 65.625 for plain vLLM (1.31x) and 91.05 for the official path (94.5%), with zero recorded errors. This is one narrow historical cell, not a general performance guarantee or current-host ECPA NPU qualification.
components.public_effect_zh: 固定版本的 192 并发、no-keepalive 单点实验记录为：薄适配 86.025 steps/min，普通 vLLM 65.625（1.31 倍），官方路径 91.05（达到 94.5%），且记录错误数为零。这只是一个窄范围历史实验单元，不代表普遍性能保证，也不等同于当前宿主上的 ECPA NPU 资格。

ECPA enablement, a rendered plan, environment variables or a successful health check do not establish runtime effectiveness; live effectiveness requires evidence from the running controller, and current-host native NPU qualification remains pending.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 服务启动、停止、升级和回滚由外部 operator 负责；当前控制器只接受一个后端。ECPA enable、渲染计划、环境变量或健康检查成功都不能证明 runtime_effective；运行生效必须由实际控制器提供证据，当前宿主的原生 NPU 资格仍待完成。
